        required: true
        type: string
      python-version:
        description: "Python version"
        required: true
        type: string
      torch-version:
        description: "PyTorch version"
        required: true
        type: string
      cuda-version:
        description: "CUDA version"
        required: true
        type: string
      runner:
        description: "Runner type"
        required: false
        type: string
